supporting_observations.claim: WS-EBROOKS-01 made several connections to 10.54.20.30 on port 8080, the inventory-listed explicit proxy. Examples occur at 13:39:11, 13:43:58, 13:48:59, 13:53:54, 13:59:21, 14:04:10, and 14:08:46 UTC.

Some observed proxy connections are separated by roughly five minutes, and several have response sizes near 46 KB; this is consistent with periodic activity but does not identify its application or destination.
The available Zeek connection records show connections to the internal proxy over HTTP on port 8080; they do not show the external destination or establish that the traffic was HTTPS.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor status reports that WS-EBROOKS-01 winsec and Sysmon logs were not collected during 13:20–14:20 UTC.
The supplied sensor status reports that PROXY-BLU-01 proxy logs were not collected during 13:20–14:20 UTC, preventing review of proxy request details such as destination host or URL.
Zeek connection collection was available, but the provided connection records identify only the workstation-to-proxy connection for this activity.
claims_not_established: Whether the periodic connections were made by approved StockPilot software or another process.
Whether the proxy connections tunneled HTTPS, and the external hostname, IP, or URL involved.
What data, if any, was sent to or received from the external service.
Whether the activity was authorized or malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs for the alert window, including CONNECT requests, destination hostnames, response status, and byte counts.
Obtain endpoint process and network telemetry for WS-EBROOKS-01 during the alert window to attribute the connections to an executable and user.
Obtain TLS/SNI or equivalent destination metadata for the connections and verify whether the destination is update.stockpilot.com.
Confirm whether StockPilot is installed and whether its update checks account for the observed timing.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: a Kerberos service ticket for ken.ito was requested from the WS-EBROOKS-01 address, followed by a network logon for ken.ito to WS-KITO-01 from that address. This is outside the alerted proxy activity and merits validation against the stated remote-administration practice. (T196-00087, T196-00088, T196-00090)

Separate review: WS-EBROOKS-01 connected to FILE-BLU-01 over SMB at 14:13:51 UTC, and FILE-BLU-01 recorded an ANONYMOUS LOGON using NTLM. This occurs after the alert's stated activity interval and does not determine this alert's disposition. (T196-00415, T196-00419)
